vibe: Professional B2B SaaS, Strategy-first, Enterprise, Analytical

layout_and_spacing.style: Technical Grid - exposed skeletons, flat surfaces, minimal radii

surface_strategies.header_and_nav: Crystal Glass: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A0A0A]/70 border-b border-white/10 shadow-[0_4px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)]
surface_strategies.cards: Flat background (#141414), 1px solid border (#262626), no soft shadows. On hover, translate-y-[-2px] with border-white/20.
surface_strategies.ai_elements: Subtle inner glow via box-shadow (inset 0 0 12px rgba(139,92,246,0.15)) and 1px border (#8B5CF6/30) to distinguish AI-generated insights.

components.inputs: bg-[#0A0A0A] border border-[#262626] text-white focus:border-[#0055FF] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#0055FF] transition-all
components.badges: px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-wider rounded-sm
components.data_tables: border-collapse w-full text-sm text-left, headers in small_label typography, rows with border-b border-[#262626] hover:bg-[#141414]

motion_and_interactions.focus_states: High contrast ring (ring-2 ring-offset-2 ring-offset-[#0A0A0A] ring-[#0055FF])
motion_and_interactions.loading: Use mono_font ASCII spinners or sharp linear indeterminate progress bars (no generic circular spinners)

icons.style: Duotone or Regular weight, strictly functional

images.description: Dummy user avatars for lead lists and team members
Logos for enriched B2B leads or partner integrations

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. Do NOT use Tailwind default slate/gray colors. Use custom hex codes or extended config.
Data-testid attributes are MANDATORY on all interactive elements (buttons, links, forms, tabs, dropdowns).
Avoid standard Vercel/Shadcn card looks. Eliminate drop shadows. Use flat borders (1px) for a technical 'Control Room' grid feel.
Use Cabinet Grotesk for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body. Do not default to Inter.
For the AI Chat Assistant, use the 'Accent AI' purple strictly for borders, text, or small badges. Do not flood backgrounds with purple. Keep it dark.
For Kanban board, ensure clear column separation with grid borders (border-r) rather than floating columns.
Never use fully transparent header backgrounds. Always use backdrop-blur glassmorphism.
Implement charts using Recharts with the chart_palette defined. Make backgrounds transparent and strokes crisp.
